Subject: Candidate day mosaic: layered panels + evaluator shadowing

Team — putting this thread together to finalize Priya Shah's virtual fullloop on Friday (candidate confirmed 9:30–13:30 PT availability). Goal: keep the day tight (4x30m panels + 15m debriefs) and add a 20m "shadow" window where a backup evaluator listens in for continuity. Key asks below: 

- Confirm primary panel owners (tech, system design, infra, product). I tentatively assigned: Laura (tech), Marissa (system design), Logan (infra), Vanessa (product/behavioral).
- We need one shadow (remote) who can join the end of Panel 2 and stay muted through Panel 4 for handoff context — who can take this?
- Quiet-window: 12:00–12:20 PT reserved for candidate break + scorecard freewrite. Please avoid scheduling demos or ops calls there.
- Attachments: resume + runbook (panel timing, evaluator prompts). I attached PRiya_Shah_Resume.pdf and panel_runbook_v2.docx.

Please reply with: confirmed / can cover shadow / any changes to timing. I will then send the candidate-facing invite with a compact agenda and Zoom link.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai

[Attachment: Priya_Shah_Resume.pdf (pdf), panel_runbook_v2.docx (docx)]

Thanks, Vanessa — Friday 9:30–13:30 PT works great. Appreciate the heads-up on the quiet break. A couple quick notes: 

- I have a short conflict 11:10–11:25 PT (medical) — should be able to rejoin quickly; if that timing collides with an active panel we can swap order.
- I prefer a brief product-behavioral check earlier in the loop rather than at the very end (helps me warm up).

Happy to accept the invite once the final agenda is set.

Best,
Priya

Thanks all — updating thread with the final agenda and calendar invites sent to Priya and the panel. Summary below (times PT):

9:30–10:00 — Panel A: Product + behavioral (Vanessa)
10:05–10:35 — Panel B: Infra (Logan)
10:40–11:10 — Panel C: System design (Marissa)
11:10–11:25 — Candidate short break (Priya's note)
11:25–11:55 — Panel D: Tech deep-dive (Laura)
12:00–12:20 — Quiet-window / scorecard freewrite (all evaluators)
12:25–12:40 — Shadow handoff (shadow: Laura will join muted at Panel B and remain for context)
12:40–13:30 — Internal debrief & decision sync (panel only)

Notes: 
- I swapped the system design and tech deep-dive per Laura's suggestion to accommodate Priya's short window.
- Laura confirmed she can act as the shadow; Logan retains the infra primary slot.
- I included a 5m buffer before Panel D and a quiet 20m window for freewrite as requested.
- Attachments and the Zoom link are in the calendar invite and the runbook doc above. Please do not forward the runbook externally; it's for panel prep only.

Priya — confirmed the new ordering with your note applied. Looking forward to meeting you Friday.
